baseline: original P1 W20 k2 Q; StandardScaler; full15 stats ddof0; unchanged P0 k2 Q fallback; no postprocess
comparison: Recall strictly increases, F2 strictly increases, F1 nondecrease, FPR<=baselineFPR+delta and <=.01
integer_rule: max extra FP=floor(N_normal*delta); never allow a minimum of1; absolute max floor(N_normal*.01)
selection: pooled F2 descending, FPR ascending, Recall descending, F1 descending, complexity ascending, stable candidate ID
tolerance_use: metric equalities/ties only; FP integer budgets exact Decimal floor
normalization: original Q95 references; modified full system recalibrated normal-only
experiment_B: conditional; at most2 hypotheses and24 configurations; no global feature replacement

selection_scope: original selection all2097 rows; original train and calibration unchanged
blocks: two burst-preserving temporal diagnostic subsets of same selection, not new folds/holdout; windows not reset at diagnostic reporting boundary
fit: normal original train only; original train_role boundaries retained
historical: already exposed; only reproduced baseline before freeze, at most5 unique frozen configurations after
prior_exposure: both original development and historical evaluation have been seen; no new independent validation
